bullets.text: Plug a **USB-C cable** into the charging port.
Give it a full charge before first use.
Press the power button once while off to check battery — **5 LEDs = full, 1 LED = low**.

steps.title: Set Up
steps.imageAlt: Setting up the G Pen Hyer on a glass rig

bullets.text: Insert the **glass adapter end** of the Hyer housing into the **14mm female joint** of your glass rig.
Load concentrate into the bottom of the **Concentrates Tank**.
Place the **tank cap** on top — thread your dab tool into the side hole for easy access.

note.text: **14mm male glass adapter** is included. Other adapter sizes sold separately.

steps.title: Set Heat
steps.imageAlt: Setting heat level on the G Pen Hyer

bullets.text: **Hold the power button for 3 seconds** to turn on.
Press **Left or Right** to cycle through the 5 heat levels.

press.sub: Hold the power button for 3 seconds

steps.title: Draw
steps.imageAlt: Drawing from the G Pen Hyer

bullets.text: **Double-click** the power button to activate a session.
Draw through your glass piece while the session runs.
**Single click** or wait for the timer to end the session.

press.sub: Hold the side button during a session

note.text: **After your session:** Wait at least 1 minute, then wipe the quartz chamber with a cotton swab while still warm.

faq.question: Device won't turn on
faq.answer: Hold the power button for a full 3 seconds. If nothing happens, charge the device. Press the power button once while off to check the battery level — only 1 LED lit means it needs a charge.

faq.question: How do I check the battery level?
faq.answer: Press the power button once while the device is off. The 5 LED dots show remaining charge — 1 LED means 0–20%, 5 LEDs means 80–100%.

faq.question: Vapor flavor or density is off
faq.answer: Clean the quartz chamber regularly with a cotton swab after sessions while still warm. Residue buildup is the most common cause of off flavor. Try a lower heat level for a cleaner, more flavorful draw.

faq.question: How do I change the session timer?
faq.answer: While the device is on, hold the Left and Right buttons simultaneously for 2 seconds. Each press cycles through 15, 30, 45, 60, or 75 seconds. The concentrate timer applies to the Concentrates Tank — the dry herb timer cycles separately if you have the dry herb tank attachment.
